submissions.decision-evidenced-short-settlement-reco:
WITH fees AS (
  SELECT transfer_code, SUM(CAST(SUBSTR(note_text, LENGTH('Debited USD cents ') + 1) AS INTEGER)) AS fee_cents, GROUP_CONCAT(note_id, ',') AS source_ids
  FROM (
    SELECT transfer_code, note_id, note_text
    FROM bank_note
    WHERE note_text GLOB 'Debited USD cents *'
    ORDER BY transfer_code COLLATE BINARY, note_id COLLATE BINARY
  )
  GROUP BY transfer_code COLLATE BINARY
)
SELECT t.transfer_code, MAX(0, t.instructed_cents - t.credited_cents - COALESCE(f.fee_cents, 0)) AS unexplained_cents, f.source_ids
FROM incoming_transfer AS t
LEFT JOIN fees AS f ON t.transfer_code COLLATE BINARY = f.transfer_code
WHERE t.credited_cents < t.instructed_cents
ORDER BY unexplained_cents DESC, t.transfer_code COLLATE BINARY

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT leaf_no, face_code, file_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY leaf_no, face_code ORDER BY event_no DESC) AS rn
  FROM face_event
  WHERE event_no <= (SELECT cut_no FROM release_cut)
), pairs AS (
  SELECT leaf_no, MAX(CASE WHEN face_code = 'r' THEN file_name END) AS recto, MAX(CASE WHEN face_code = 'v' THEN file_name END) AS verso
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
  GROUP BY leaf_no
)
SELECT 'leaf_no,recto,verso' || CHAR(10) || COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(record, ''), '') AS csv_body
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(leaf_no AS TEXT) || ',"' || REPLACE(recto, '"', '""') || '","' || REPLACE(verso, '"', '""') || '"' || CHAR(10) AS record
  FROM pairs
  WHERE recto IS NOT NULL AND verso IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY leaf_no
)
